# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Workspace & UI Comfort

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of notebook overview, metadata, theme, and language requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are notebook identification fields, including the icon, title, creation and modification dates, Ready-source count, and localized count label, all specified? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements FR-001, FR-WM-02]
- [x] CHK002 Are the default, first-Ready-source Flash-Lite topic-derived, and manually selected emoji states, model failure behavior, and overwrite rules fully defined? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements FR-002–FR-003, FR-WM-02]
- [x] CHK003 Are all view modes, sort modes, pin behavior, last-opened fallback, role label, and empty-notebook state specified? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements FR-005–FR-009, FR-WM-03]
- [x] CHK004 Are global and notebook-level input/output preferences, the supported-language minimum, input `auto`, and effective output precedence documented? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements FR-011–FR-013, FR-UI-02]
- [x] CHK005 Are the v2.0 owner-only scope and the deferral of non-owner preference overrides explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements FR-015, FR-WM-02/03, FR-UI-02]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “single valid Unicode emoji grapheme cluster” defined clearly enough to distinguish valid ZWJ, flag, and skin-tone sequences from multiple emoji or arbitrary text? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements FR-003, FR-WM-02]
- [x] CHK007 Is the first Ready-source topic-icon source and the condition for retaining the default icon clear without allowing a later ingest to replace a custom icon? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements FR-002, FR-WM-02]
- [x] CHK008 Are both creation and modified dates required in list rows, consistent with FR-001 and the package reference? [Ambiguity, Spec §Requirements FR-001, FR-006, FR-WM-02/03]
- [x] CHK009 Are the versioned 40 supported output-language choices and the supported-locale fallback rule explicit? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements FR-012, FR-UI-02]
- [x] CHK010 Does the theme requirement state that System follows `prefers-color-scheme` and that initial theme application precedes first paint? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements FR-010, FR-UI-02]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are source-count and notebook-modification requirements consistent for Ready, failed, added, removed, renamed, and in-flight sources? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements FR-001, FR-004, FR-WM-02]
- [x] CHK012 Are pinned-first ordering, each sort’s direction/fallback, and stable outcomes consistent across grid and list views? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements FR-005, FR-007, FR-WM-03]
- [x] CHK013 Is the language preference precedence consistent between user story, FR-012/FR-013, entities, and edge-case requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements FR-011–FR-013, FR-UI-02]
- [x] CHK014 Are the global preference persistence requirement and browser-local view/sort persistence consistent about ownership and scope? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements FR-008, FR-010–FR-012, FR-WM-03, FR-UI-02]

## Acceptance Criteria and Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK015 Can the 200 ms metadata, 100 ms/500-notebook organization, and 50 ms theme targets be measured under a named or consistently defined environment? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001–SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Are exactly 40 versioned output-language choices and the supported-locale fallback objectively specified? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-004, FR-UI-02]
- [x] CHK017 Are the visible results of all home overview and settings interactions objectively covered by acceptance scenarios, including a custom icon, first-source topic icon, error cases, and original-language citation text? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing, FR-WM-02, FR-WM-03, FR-UI-02, FR-GC-03]

## Edge Cases and Dependencies

- [x] CHK018 Are invalid emoji values, failed ingestion, zero notebooks, unsupported locale, missing preferences, and per-owner isolation all addressed with explicit outcomes? [Coverage, Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-WM-02/03, FR-UI-02]
- [x] CHK019 Are prerequisites on FR-WM-01, FR-SI-01, and FR-UI-01 and the fact that generator behavior belongs to later packages documented without implying that this package implements it? [Dependency, Spec §Source Traceability & Package Scope, Assumptions & Out of Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers unless the reviewer explicitly requests a quality review
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
